title: Quiz Questions
description: Array of quiz questions used for export and import by the Battleship quiz editor. The same shape is returned by the API (GET /api/quiz/questions, GET /api/quiz-templates/{id}) and accepted by the save endpoints (POST /api/quiz/questions, POST /api/quiz-templates).

question_text.description: The question text shown to players.

bomb_value.description: Maximum bombs this question can yield. Equals the highest bomb_value among its answers. Editor convenience field; re-derived from answers on import.

source_url.description: Optional URL that verifies the correct answer, only revealed after the team has answered. Empty string or null when unset. Scheme-less input (e.g. 'example.com') is auto-prefixed with https:// on save; non-http schemes (javascript:, data:) are rejected.

answers.description: Answer options. Must contain exactly one correct answer and at least one answer with bomb_value ≥ 1.

allOf.description: At least one answer must yield bombs.
Exactly one answer must be marked correct.

answer_text.description: The answer text shown to players.

bomb_value.description: Bombs this answer yields. One answer per question must have bomb_value ≥ 1.

is_correct.description: Whether this is the correct answer. Exactly one answer per question should be true.
